metadata.GT: source fitted MANO references; unchanged recording-disjoint four-source splits; no test labels
metadata.position_units: metres in noisy-history wrist anchor frame
metadata.sampling: full shuffled coverage, disjoint rank shards, no dropped final batch

config.best_selection_description: Current geometry weighted clean/reanchor/noisy/missing/local-strong 20/20/35/20/5, diagnostic strata rather than exact mixture risk; transient cases and legacy stress also reported.

corruption_profile.target_policy: All current and future targets remain uncorrupted source reference trajectories
corruption_profile.amplitude_convention: event peak actual norm/angle within severity band; ramp instantaneous amplitude can be below peak lower bound; other groups/frames clean or <=1mm/degree; no additive full errors
corruption_profile.amplitude_sampling: Peak norm/angle uniform within light/medium or rare strong range; direction shared within plateau/ramp/scattered, per-frame independent for jitter

temporal_noise.process: window-local jitter, fixed-vector plateau, ramp or scattered events; one to four frames; current covers onset/continuation and reanchor covers recovery
temporal_noise.limitations: events are redrawn across independently sampled overlapping windows, not recording-persistent or learned rollout errors

quality.oracle_quality: optional separately labeled ablation only; not the default condition

corruption_profile.source_sampling: finite full traversal of original four-source train windows; no new images required

evaluation.paired_corruption_seed: noisy/history_only use matching draws; fixed duration modes can change RNG schedule

limitations: Mixture, durations, amplitudes and feature scale are engineering hypotheses, not fitted to HaWoR
No future observations or oracle event/quality labels fed to model
References remain fitted MANO; not independent physical ground truth
Window-local error process is not a closed-loop deployment distribution
corruption_profile.execution_policy: Explicitly selected by a fresh training run; old checkpoints/runs remain preserved
corruption_profile.window_cases_description: Reanchor event ends 1..4 frames before current; other nonclean cases include current in error/missing event. All clean case is exact.

scope: Recorded fixed synthetic validation only; source-fitted MANO references, equal-source macro means. No new model evaluation, no test labels, no real HaWoR or independent sensor accuracy claim.
